text.tspan: C_SD_HF / C_SD_BULK: parallel capacitors drawn end-to-end.
J_SD / TP_SD_CLK: clock test point below its connector pin.
Capacitors beside one another; clock test point aligned with pin 5.
Complete microSD sheet. Symbols, pin layouts and electrical connections preserved.
